# `vector_inner_product`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
vector_inner_product(array1, array2)
```

Returns the inner product (dot product) between two float vectors.
The vectors must have the same dimension.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `vector_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT vector_inner_product(array(1.0F, 2.0F, 3.0F), array(4.0F, 5.0F, 6.0F));
```

Result:

```text
32.0
```
